program.name: Nurturing Futures
program.description_short: Monthly cash payments for Boulder County families with a child under 4
program.description:
This program gives Boulder County families with young children cash each month. Families can use the money for rent, food, child care, health care, or other needs.

Boulder County uses AidKit to manage applications and payments. AidKit sends your payment using the method you choose. The amount shown is the program’s monthly payment, not an estimate.

You must keep living in Boulder County while you get payments. If your child was born in November 2022, they must have been born on Nov. 3 or later. Your household is you, your partner, and anyone who depends on you for most of their costs — not roommates. Health First Colorado or Colorado Works can count as proof that your income meets the limit. Some types of Health First Colorado may not count as proof. A child under 4 can only be listed on one application. If two households share custody, only the first application is accepted.

These payments might impact other benefits you get, like SNAP and Colorado Works. Check the Benefits Guide or ask your benefits office how your benefits could change.

If you are applying for the first time, select “Apply Online” to start your application. If you already get this benefit, use the reapplication link sent to you by email or text.

program.estimated_decision_time: Within four weeks after the application deadline

documents.text: Photo ID — a driver's license, passport, or state ID. May be expired up to 2 years.
Proof you live in Boulder County — a utility bill or pay stub from the last 90 days. Not a PO box.
Proof of income for everyone who earns, like a pay stub.
Health First Colorado or Colorado Works case number, if anyone in your household has one.
Proof a child under 4 lives with you — a birth certificate or childcare record.
